source_level_gain: Proved source-convention total-variation cutoff for reversal-augmented symmetrized arc graphs of fixed-degree edge-transitive long-range-expander bases. The output graphs are vertex-transitive spectral expanders outside every fixed long-range-expansion constant. Center: ((2d-1)/(d-2)) log_{d-1} n, equivalently ((2d-1)/(d-2)) log_{d-1}(N/d), with O(sqrt(log N)) window.
mechanism_gain: Exact lazy line-graph lumping plus odd Hodge-Green L1 cancellation for the reversal-augmented arc graph; separately, proved uniform exponential concentration of root-stabilizer orbit sizes under stationarity from transitivity plus spectral expansion, and the exact identity V_KL(t)=Var_{nu_t}(log(nu_t/barpi)(Y_t)), eliminating quotient rank/orbit-size terms from the dynamic information variable.
obstruction_removed: The previous (log r)^2 stabilizer-quotient rank penalty is an artifact: stationary orbit-size surprisal has O_{d,gamma}(1) variance and orbit sizes cancel exactly from the time-t likelihood ratio. High quotient rank is therefore not itself an information-theoretic obstruction.
remaining_obstruction: Control the time-t quotient likelihood-ratio varentropy Var_{nu_t}(log(nu_t/barpi)) from vertex transitivity plus ordinary spectral expansion, without a supplied spherical/product/Hodge factorization.
continuity: Preserves the pre-LIVE NM13-01 handoff and all earlier T08 classes. The immediately preceding arc-cover theorem remains valid and untouched; this run changes the graph by adding the reversal matching and weakens the base symmetry assumption from arc-transitive to edge-transitive.
partner_split: P26's newest checked route is trimmed Green/spherical transfer with exceptional modes and mixed-distance outputs; this run uses a transitivity/Hodge quotient route and does not duplicate that mechanism.
next_attack: Use the exact quotient-density identity to seek an L1/log-likelihood gradient or occupation-time estimate on stabilizer quotients; stress-test first on high-rank transitive expanders where ambient L2 and raw NBRW trace are misleading.
